name: The Coveted Mirror
source:
Main character is caught by the enemy and starts in prison. He needs to break free and explore Japanese castle to find five pieces of the mystery mirror within time limit.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被敌人抓获，故事开始时正身陷牢狱。他必须逃出监牢，探索一座日式城堡，在限定时间内找到神秘镜子的五块碎片。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
